mechanism: Coenzyme Q10 may antagonize the anticoagulant effects of verapamil and potentially reduce its cardioprotective benefits through its own cardiac effects, while verapamil may deplete cellular CoQ10 levels as a statin-like effect.
action: Monitor cardiac function and consider CoQ10 supplementation if verapamil-induced depletion is suspected; counsel patient on potential reduced efficacy and maintain consistent dosing of both agents.
